contextReview.basis: Direct review: cloudy night harbour promenade with warm stucco walls, wall lamps and moored boats; no rain depicted (dry-looking paving); humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The black hydration running vest (shoulder strips, two chest buckles, no centre zip) is a separate product from the cobalt long-sleeve top, which owns the silver upper-arm bands. The paper cup is a scene prop. Hidden backs, vest pockets and soles are inferred. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All28 viewed on4 backgrounds: no opaque rectangles, obvious halos or clipping. Shapes/colors match editorials.03 hydration vest has two chest buckles and no center zip, blue top owns upper-arm bands.05 jacket full sleeves reconstructed from pushed-up rear view; gray inner separate. Shoe pairs aligned overhead; socks paired; watch and cap complete. Hidden details conservative, no brand/verified-performance claim.

intro.ko: 바람에 기운 종이컵을 손끝으로 재빨리 붙잡습니다.
intro.en: He quickly catches a paper cup tipped by the breeze.
intro.de: Er fängt den vom Wind gekippten Papierbecher schnell auf.

body.ko: 검정 하이드레이션 베스트의 두 가슴 버클과 수납부가 코발트 톱 위에 선을 만듭니다. 반사 밴드는 파란 위팔을 따라가고, 여유 있는 회색 팬츠는 타이츠와 다른 실루엣을 만듭니다. 검정 신발과 짧은 양말로 아래쪽을 간결하게 정리했습니다. 종이컵은 제품 목록에 포함하지 않는 장면 소품입니다.
body.en: Two chest buckles and front pockets define the black hydration vest over the cobalt top. Reflective bands follow the blue upper arms, while relaxed gray trousers create a different line from tights. Black shoes and short socks keep the lower half simple. The paper cup remains a scene prop.
body.de: Zwei Brustschnallen und Vordertaschen zeichnen die schwarze Laufweste über dem kobaltblauen Shirt. Reflexbänder folgen den blauen Oberarmen; lockere graue Hosenbeine unterscheiden sich von Tights. Schwarze Schuhe und kurze Socken halten den unteren Teil ruhig. Der Becher bleibt ein Szenenrequisit.
